topic_resolution.description: This cluster of papers focuses on competition law, market power, and regulatory frameworks in the European Union. It explores topics such as the Digital Markets Act, EU competition law, consumer protection, antitrust regulation, platform economy, unfair trading practices, and corporate governance. The papers analyze the role of producer organizations, the impact of public payment delays, and the implications of excessive pharmaceutical prices on public health.
